newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APP Global Finance seen setting structured FRN.
newsitem.headline: APP Global Finance seen setting structured FRN.

text.p: Special-purpose vehicle APP Global Finance is seeking financing via a structured floating rate note issue, bankers said on Tuesday.
The issue is expected to be US$400 million or more in size and carry a tenor of five years. Indicated pricing is between 400 and 425 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, bankers said.
They said the issue is secured by a pledge of shares in APP Finance Mauritius, which can be exchanged into preferred shares of Asia Pulp and Paper.
Peregrine Fixed Income reportedly is arranging the deal, but the company declined to comment.
Bankers said roadshows for the issue will be held, starting next week in Asia.
They said the issue is similar to a deal arranged for APP Global Finance by Union Bank of Switzerland last year.
Asia Pulp and Paper, one of the world's largest pulp and paper companies, has 15 manufacturing plants in Indonesia and China. It is listed in New York and headquartered in Singapore.
